factual_errors.claim: 进程内 ExtensionHost（FileSystemLoader）和远程 WebSocketExtensionPeer 各自实现了 extension:* 握手
factual_errors.repository_evidence: packages/plugin-sdk/src/plugin-host/core.ts bootstraps sessions via in-memory extension.setup(ctx); packages/server-sdk/src/extension-peer.ts sends 'extension:announce'/'extension:module:announce' wire events; packages/plugin-sdk/src/plugin-host/runtimes/node/index.ts throws 'WebSocket transport is not implemented for node runtime yet.'
factual_errors.explanation: The in-process host does not perform the extension:* wire handshake; it uses in-memory setup(). Only the remote peer implements the wire events. The imprecision does not weaken the conclusion (two separate paths, not one deployment choice) — the unimplemented transport stubs actually reinforce it.

rationale: The answer is an exceptionally well-grounded architecture review. It classifies the repo (monorepo; Electron stage-tamagotchi as the desktop surface) from multiple signals, cites verified file:line evidence across the plugin host, registry, plugin-sdk core/permissions/loader, plugin-protocol events, kits/gamelet orchestration, static-assets, server-runtime, server-sdk, channel-server, http-server, and window manager, and explicitly distinguishes fact from inference and current evidence from intent. Its friction analysis (main-process plugin execution, per-window hand-writing, two parallel server lifecycles, unwired permissionResolver, composition-root bloat) is accurate. It provides three viable options including the status quo, ranks quality attributes with explicit trade-offs, gives a recommendation that follows from the evidence, and lays out an incremental, observable, reversible migration with concrete verification. General principles (freeze stable contracts, defer isolation/frameworks until demanded) are correctly attributed rather than smuggled from project specifics. No material factual errors and no unresolved decision-relevant conflicts; two minor inaccuracies (window dependency counts, handshake phrasing) are non-decision-relevant. All nine dimensions earn full credit.
